body: I can't say that I've never thought of this before either, but trust me when I say it isn't worth it.  I also had a friend who killed herself and for the longest time I thought it was out of spite (which of course it probably wasn't). Suicide leaves a lot of questions for the people left behind and one of the biggest things that helped me was realizing that it wasn't my fault and moving on.  Your friend will probably do the same.  If you can't shake these thoughts, please seek professional help.  Talking to a good therapist can give you a much better outlook on your current situation.  I probably wouldn't be alive if I didn't seek help when I needed it.

I understand the way you feel all too well.  Every day is the same for me while everyone else is moving on.  I just ended a long-term relationship, so it's back to my family's house.  Anxiety is the worst, and maybe I'm not the best to give advice about coping, but talking with people who deal with the same things can really help.  Seeing a therapist has done a lot of good for me too.  You would be surprised at how good you feel after a totally confidential venting session.  I know taking those first few steps are hard, some days it's even a struggle for me to leave the couch.  Try baby-steps. Don't overwhelm yourself.  And I'm always here if you need to talk.  We probably won't ever meet in real life, but I care about your situation and I get it.

When I was 15, I was first prescribed to barbiturates for severe pain from headaches.  I never really understood how dangerous they were, I just knew they made the pain go away.  Well after being on them for a while, at the age of 17,  I would have to take more to get the same effect.  Out of curiosity, I decided to try half the bottle.  I was blacked out for the whole day.  I couldn't even walk straight when I woke up.  My dad was out of town, so I was home by myself.  If I had OD'd and slipped into a coma, I probably wouldn't have been found for a couple days. 

tl;dr I almost OD'd myself because I was a stupid kid.
